metadata.description: Content and workflow plugins: transcript extraction, summarization, reusable publishing tasks, and autonomous planning/execution.

plugins.name: youtube-transcript
plugins.description: Extract YouTube captions/transcripts, transcribe local audio/video files, summarize transcript files, and fall back to OpenAI audio transcription when captions are unavailable.

plugins.name: supergoal
plugins.description: Plan and autonomously build a software task end-to-end under a single /goal, with retry, fix-spec recovery, per-phase memory writeback, and a final audit. Cross-platform (PowerShell + POSIX helpers). Adapted for Windows from supergoal by Robert Courson.

plugins.name: autonomous-run
plugins.description: Configure Claude Code for a long unattended run: auto permissions, dynamic-workflow subagent fan-out, /goal or /loop persistence, cloud execution, and end-to-end self-verification. Detects which levers are available and hands off cleanly. Pairs with supergoal.

plugins.name: outcome
plugins.description: Turn a requirement, idea, or transcript into ONE outcome doc per capability: a protected 60-second §0 TLDR (outcome, verbatim rules mapped to acceptance-test IDs, success signal), then agent-derived invariants, mechanism with file:line evidence, Given/When/Then acceptance, and build phases. Includes a code-verified review rubric for docs authored elsewhere and a red-test arm mode.
